description.value:
Prerequisites Widen the Hollow

You may Parley with your dormant second spirit without swapping it into the primary seat. The Parley costs double the Toll it would otherwise cost, minimum 2. The dormant spirit answers as itself, using its own Covenant's boons and its own temperament; your primary spirit is aware you did it, and the GM may say so.

cinderfall.incomplete: Spends "double Toll (minimum 2)," which has zero rule-element representation anywhere in the corpus -- the doubled-cost mechanic has nothing to double. Its prerequisite, "Widen the Hollow," is a level-5 baseline class-progression grant described only in classes.hollowbound.json's flags.cinderfall.progression table, not a card of its own anywhere in this corpus -- there is no base "second dormant spirit slot" mechanic to attach a Parley-cost-doubling rule to either.
